$$\begin{align*}5k+7&=(3k+2)(k-1)\\5k+7&=3k^2-k-2\\3k^2-6k-9&=0\\(k-3)(k+1)&=0\\k&=3\text{ or }-1\end{align*}$$

The discriminant is $5^2-4(2)(-6)=73$.
